entries.zh: 鞭打、抽打（以小物击打尊者或长辈，即以下犯上之打；毆打）
entries.en: to whip, flog (beating an inferior or lesser one with a small whip; to strike, beat)
entries.notes: 西语 açotar 本义鞭笞，词头注明 el menor a el mayor（以下击上），与「毆打」四栏对应，展开依赖推断故中等。

entries.zh: 笞杖、杖刑（以竹杖或细条抽打，如杖责仆役）
entries.en: to flog with a rod or canes (bambu staff), as with a mandarin's cane; to birch
to be whipped on the back; to slash/scourge the back
entries.notes: 汉栏仅一「削」字，与西语 açotarse en las espaldas（鞭背）对应关系弱，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 下（鞭笞的量词，若干「下」之打）
entries.en: a stroke (numeral classifier for lashes of the whip)
cane whip for the horse; goad, switch
cane whip for the horse (compound: whip-stick)
wooden stick/club; to beat with a stick, punishment; to strike

entries.zh: （买卖时）买进抬价、卖出减价；增减
entries.en: to raise in buying and lower in selling (bargain in trade); to increase and decrease

entries.zh: 凑起来、聚增（积累增多，即增长）
entries.en: to heap up, accumulate, grow more (cf. crecer)
entries.notes: 「湊起來」为口语组合，与 crecer 对应依赖推断，中等置信。

entries.zh: 褒（称赞、嘉许，使声誉增光）
entries.en: to praise, commend, give credit (cf. alabar)
to praise and reward; to commend with a prize
creditor; the master/owner of a debt
to refine, purify (as metal in a crucible)

entries.zh: 交感（肉身之交，即行淫、交媾）
entries.en: carnal act, i.e. to fornicate; sexual intercourse
